bullets.text: Copilot Enhancements Roll Out - **Microsoft** introduces real-time text editing features for **Copilot** on Windows, enhancing collaboration.
Microsoft Store Milestones - Over 250 million monthly users engaged with a more personalized **Microsoft Store** experience in 2025.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features and improvements are rolling out in **Windows 11** Insider Preview Build 26220.7523.
AI-Driven Security Insights - New **Microsoft** e-book highlights the need for unified, AI-ready security platforms over fragmented tools.
Gartner Recognition for AI Platforms - **Microsoft** named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI Application Development Platforms.
PowerToys Advanced Paste Feature - **PowerToys** introduces an AI-powered clipboard management tool for versatile content pasting.
Access Fabric for Security - **Microsoft** unveils a unified approach to identity and network access, enhancing security against cyber threats.
Windows 11 Gaming Updates - Full screen experience now available on more handheld devices, enhancing gaming on **Windows 11**.
Defending Against CVE-2025-55182 - **Microsoft** provides insights and mitigation strategies for a critical vulnerability in React Server Components.
Copilot Studio Updates - **Microsoft Copilot Studio** enhances agent-driven workflows with new capabilities announced at Ignite 2025.
